name: mdlaug-repair
description: Browser extension that repairs, re-presents, and audits digital libraries against the mDLAUG accessibility guidelines.

scripts.check: for f in extension/engine/*.js extension/src/*.js extension/ui/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('extension/manifest.json'))" && echo ok
